message: Every time I upload a CSV larger than 5 MB I get error 504. Smaller files go through fine.

classification.rationale: The message describes an error occurring during a specific action (uploading large CSV files).

enrichment.core_issue: The customer receives error 504 when uploading CSV files larger than 5 MB.

summary: The customer reports receiving error 504 when uploading CSV files larger than 5 MB, while smaller files upload successfully. The issue appears to be isolated to larger files.
